title: Constructors inside abstract classes
answer: Yes. An abstract class can have constructors even though you cannot instantiate the abstract class directly. A subclass constructor invokes an abstract superclass constructor to initialize inherited state before the subclass initializes its own state. This is useful when every concrete subclass must share validated fields or common initialization logic.
